commands.name: dns-lookup
commands.title: DNS Lookup
commands.description: Check DNS propagation instantly with Google, Cloudflare, Alibaba and DNS.SB (DoH or classic DNS) or global propagation with worldwide DNS servers.

preferences.name: fastCheckTransport
preferences.title: Fast Check Transport
preferences.description: How Fast Check reaches the public resolvers. Auto uses DNS over HTTPS and falls back to classic DNS (UDP port 53) when HTTPS lookups are blocked.

preferences.name: globalpingToken
preferences.title: Globalping API Key
preferences.description: Optional: get a free API key from https://www.globalping.io/ to use the Global Check feature with higher limits.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
